title: 巴克莱辛格：AI交易逻辑生变，亚洲科技谁主沉浮？
speaker: Kanhari Singh

segments.en: Yeah, absolutely, I'm wanting even, and thanks for having me on.
segments.zh: 当然，谢谢邀请我参加节目。

segments.en: Look, I think markets are basically telling us that we are going on from, moving on from trading AI vibes and narrative, to now requiring a pretty high bar for what an earnings beat looks like.
segments.zh: 市场基本上在告诉我们，已经从交易AI氛围和叙事，转向对盈利超预期设定更高门槛。

segments.en: And you know, that's both in terms of capex forward guidance, but also for the path of monetization.
segments.zh: 这既体现在资本开支的前瞻指引上，也体现在变现路径上。

segments.en: And when I look at meta and Tesla overnight, the two things that stand out to me is,
segments.zh: 隔夜看Meta和特斯拉，有两点很突出，

segments.en: you know, Tesla's price action kind of makes sense because the company did guide for lower capex next year.
segments.zh: 特斯拉的价格走势说得通，因为公司确实指引明年资本开支下降。

segments.en: But meta's numbers were objectively strong and yet the stock struggled to hold on to its gains when Asia came in this morning.
segments.zh: 但Meta的数据客观上很强，然而亚洲今早开盘后，其股价却难以守住涨幅。

segments.en: So what that tells me for the path ahead for Asia, where we have three indices, you know, for tech expression,
segments.zh: 这对亚洲后续走势的启示是，我们有三个科技表达指数，

segments.en: Korea, Taiwan and Japan, is that the market is going to be a lot more discerning next year.
segments.zh: 韩国、台湾和日本，明年市场将更加挑剔。

segments.en: And I think respecting price action there, we think about being long quality.
segments.zh: 我认为要尊重价格走势，我们考虑做多优质资产。

segments.en: Especially in the tech space, heading into next year.
segments.zh: 尤其是在科技领域，进入明年之际。
